key_insight: Functionally specialized LLM subnetworks have very low overlap, enabling targeted continual learning that reduces interference with prior skills.
engineering_relevance: Restricting updates and optimizer states to selected subnetworks offers a path to more memory-efficient, stable LLM adaptation.
method: Locate functional subnetworks using gradient-attribution profiling.
Route each training example to its corresponding subnetwork with CiMEO.
Restrict parameter updates and optimizer states to selected regions.
evidence_signal: Across 1.4 million sequential instructions and five generative benchmarks covering programming, examination-style tasks, and mathematical reasoning, CiMEO achieved the highest average performance among compared methods while mitigating forgetting.
watch_item: The abstract does not quantify memory savings or the computational overhead of subnetwork profiling and example routing.
paper_title: Functional Subnetwork Localization for Efficient Continual Learning in Large Language Models
